# Cloudflare Workers
> Cloudflare's developer platform for building, deploying, and scaling serverless applications, APIs, and edge services.

Cloudflare Workers is part of the Cloudflare Developer Platform, providing runtime, storage, AI, observability, and deployment tooling for applications that run globally at the edge.

## Getting Started
- [Cloudflare Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/): Main documentation hub for building and deploying Workers applications.
- [Get Started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/get-started/guide/): Step-by-step guide to create and deploy your first Worker.
- [Wrangler](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/): CLI for developing, testing, and deploying Workers projects.
- [Pricing](https://workers.cloudflare.com/pricing): Pricing and plan details for the Cloudflare Developer Platform.
- [Examples](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/examples/): Example Workers demonstrating common patterns and use cases.

## Core Platform
- [How Workers Works](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/reference/how-workers-works/): Overview of the Workers runtime architecture and execution model.
- [Runtime APIs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/): Reference for built-in APIs available in the Workers runtime.
- [Bindings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/): Connect Workers to storage, AI, and external services.
- [Routes and Domains](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/routing/routes/): Configure URL routing for Workers on domains and paths.
- [Environments](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/environments/): Manage development, staging, and production Worker environments.
- [Limits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/): Platform limits, quotas, and runtime constraints.

## Development and Deployment
- [Configuration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/configuration/): Configure Workers projects with Wrangler configuration files.
- [Local Development](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/local-development/): Run and test Workers locally during development.
- [Deploy a Worker](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/commands/#deploy): Deploy Workers using Wrangler CLI commands.
- [Versions and Deployments](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/versions-and-deployments/): Manage Worker versions, rollouts, and deployment history.
- [Source Maps and Debugging](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/source-maps/): Improve debugging with source maps and stack traces.
- [Node.js Compatibility](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/nodejs/): Use supported Node.js APIs in the Workers runtime.

## Storage and Data
- [Workers KV](https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/): Globally distributed key-value storage for Workers applications.
- [R2](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/): Object storage for large files and unstructured data.
- [D1](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/): Serverless SQL database built on SQLite for Workers apps.
- [Durable Objects](https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/): Stateful coordination and storage primitives for edge applications.
- [Hyperdrive](https://developers.cloudflare.com/hyperdrive/): Accelerate and pool database connections from Workers.
- [Queues](https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/): Message queues for asynchronous processing and background workloads.
- [Vectorize](https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/): Vector database for embeddings and similarity search workloads.

## AI and Media
- [Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/): Run inference with AI models on Cloudflare's network.
- [AI Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/): Manage, observe, and control traffic to AI providers.
- [Browser Rendering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-rendering/): Run headless browser workloads and automation at the edge.
- [Images](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/): Store, transform, and deliver optimized images.
- [Stream](https://developers.cloudflare.com/stream/): Video ingestion, storage, and delivery platform.
- [Calls](https://developers.cloudflare.com/calls/): Real-time audio and video communication primitives.

## Observability and Operations
- [Observability](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/): Monitor logs, metrics, traces, and Worker health.
- [Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/logs/): View and manage Worker execution logs.
- [Metrics and Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/metrics-and-analytics/): Analyze Worker performance and usage metrics.
- [Tail Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/logs/tail-workers/): Stream Worker logs in near real time.
- [Trace Events](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/traces/): Inspect traces and execution details for requests.
- [Analytics Engine](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/analytics-engine/): Write analytics data from Workers for custom reporting.

## Frameworks and Integrations
- [Framework Guides](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/frameworks/): Build Workers apps with popular web frameworks.
- [Pages](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/): Deploy full-stack applications and static sites on Cloudflare.
- [Workers for Platforms](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-for-platforms/workers-for-platforms/): Embed Workers into your own platform or SaaS product.
- [Service Bindings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/service-bindings/): Connect Workers to other Workers services internally.
- [RPC](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/rpc/): Call methods between Workers using RPC primitives.

## Security and Access
- [Secrets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/secrets/): Store and manage sensitive configuration values securely.
- [Access Protected Resources](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/tutorials/extend-sso-with-workers/): Use Workers with Cloudflare Access and protected applications.
- [mTLS Bindings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/mtls/): Authenticate outbound requests using mutual TLS certificates.
- [Web Crypto](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/web-crypto/): Use cryptographic primitives in the Workers runtime.
- [Rate Limiting Bindings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/rate-limit/): Apply rate limiting logic from within Workers.

## Reference and Resources
- [API Reference](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/): Cloudflare API reference for platform and account operations.
- [Workers Changelog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/changelog/): Product updates, releases, and platform changes.
- [Workers Release Notes](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/release-notes/): Detailed release notes for Workers features and fixes.
- [Templates](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/templates/): Starter templates for common Workers project types.
- [Cloudflare Developers Blog](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/developers/): Engineering and product articles for Cloudflare developers.
- [Status](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/): Service status and incident reporting for Cloudflare products.
